contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, Reece period 17. Chipped. Obverse description: Bust laureate right. Obverse inscription: [---]IVN N C. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Diameter: 12.7mm, Weight: 0.69gms, die axis: 6
